<thought>To determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (~10–30 ppm). By counting the distinct peaks in that region, I can infer the number of methyl groups present.</thought>
